create_onehotencoder: create a OneHotEncoder to encode categorical features as binary columns with automatic category detection
transform_onehotencoder: transform data using OneHotEncoder to produce sparse one-hot encoded arrays
inverse_transform_onehotencoder: inverse transform one-hot encoded data back to original categorical values
get_feature_names_out_onehotencoder: get output feature names from OneHotEncoder after fitting on labeled input features
create_ordinalencoder: create an OrdinalEncoder to encode categorical features as integer arrays with infrequent category grouping
